purpose: Editorial paper artwork for the Your Optimiser landing page and journal. Illustrations are decorative, not product screenshots.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape editorial cover for Your Optimiser, an autonomous SEO agent website. Create a refined physical paper sculpture photograph: a single continuous dark forest-green paper ribbon passes through three precisely cut warm ivory architectural frames and returns in a quiet loop, suggesting ongoing inspection and repair. A small sage-green square is carefully realigned in the middle frame. Tangible fibrous paper, slight handmade irregularities, soft directional daylight, gentle true shadows on warm off-white #f7f7f0. Restrained forest green #315443, sage and cream palette matching a contemporary editorial website. Wide 3:2 composition, sculptural subject centred with generous breathing room, sophisticated art direction, crisp realistic macro textures. No people, no text, letters, logos, numbers, screens, charts, robots, neon, gradients, glossy plastic or floating UI. Feels like an art-directed design magazine photograph rather than a generic AI illustration.
assets.processing: Converted to WebP and resized with Sharp; composition preserved.

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story.
